high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from bondcap.com, displaying a chart titled "Years to 50% Adoption of Household Technologies in USA, per Morgan Stanley." The chart compares the time it took for various technologies to reach 50% household penetration during different eras: AI Era: 3 years? Mobile Internet Era: 6 years Desktop Internet Era: 12 years PC Era: 20 years Industrial Revolution: 42 years The chart uses horizontal bars to represent the duration in years for each era.
